scientific_integrity: Earlier work identifies the thirteen-point singularity basket and vertex geometric genus 45; this result specifically determines its exceptional resolution curve, normal bundle, and Milnor number. All known antecedents are credited.
scientific_limitations: General smooth transverse conics over the complex numbers only. Full analytic equivalence and deformations of the vertex, special parameters, and independent mathematical audit are not established. The genus, self-intersection, normal bundle, and local Milnor number follow from a geometric proof, not from finite enumeration.
title: A genus-\(16\) exceptional curve and Milnor-\(293\) vertex on a normal abelian nonic
